hypothesis: A six-face room can preserve one addressed object while making its opposing relations perceptually legible: PRESENT↔RETURN, INPUT↔OUTPUT, INTENTION↔EVIDENCE. Rotation changes the active reading; walking through a local door changes the object and leaves a trail.

later_interpretive: interphase_bridge_v0_2.html · 2026-04-29 · File Library descendant/reconstruction, not historical source evidence
lineage.rule: Historical room/cube code is frozen evidence. ROOM 0.1 is a new descendant that transfers only explicit mechanisms: VIEWPORT/CAMERA/ROOM, signed faces, direct rotation, focus/foveation, canonical state, projection, local trail and RETURN.

controls: route command line → load one FIELD route into the room
local wall doors → walk to related manifest routes without losing the room grammar
PLAIN baseline exposes the same manifest object without spatial projection
RETURN emits/stores an INTERPHASE-compatible local receipt
capability: Project a real FIELD route into six opposing relation faces while preserving route identity, source provenance and explicit RETURN. The ceiling carries intention, floor carries proof, left/right carry ingress/egress, front/back carry presence/provenance.
boundary: ROOM is a projection, never canonical object truth.
Rotation never mutates the addressed FIELD route.
Walking through a door changes addressed object explicitly and records a local event.
No claim that spatialization is universally superior to the PLAIN baseline.
No claim that the 2026 descendant reproduces the exact remembered historical red-dot/Alice reader.
